completed.title: Add Read Receipts DTO and Endpoint
completed.description: Add read receipt tracking for messages — DTO model + a simple controller with POST /api/readreceipts (mark message read) and GET /api/readreceipts/{conversationId} (get unread count). No SignalR push yet, just the REST API. Uses existing DbContext and auth pattern from MessagesController.
acceptanceCriteria: ReadReceiptDto with MessageId, ReaderId, ReadAt fields
ReadReceipt EF entity model with Id, MessageId, ReaderId, ReadAt
POST /api/readreceipts endpoint accepting {messageId} and marking as read
Authorize attribute on both endpoints (uses existing Keycloak JWT)
completed.safetyNotes: New files only, does not modify existing code. Read receipt is additive feature.

completed.title: Add Daily Swipe Limit Middleware
completed.description: Create a swipe rate-limiting service that tracks daily swipe counts per user. Free tier = 100 swipes/day. Includes SwipeLimitService (ISwipeLimitService interface + implementation) and SwipeLimitDto. Uses in-memory tracking via ConcurrentDictionary (production will use Redis later). Includes GET /api/swipes/limit endpoint on existing SwipesController to check remaining.
acceptanceCriteria: ISwipeLimitService interface with CanSwipe(userId), IncrementSwipe(userId), GetRemaining(userId)
SwipeLimitService implementation using ConcurrentDictionary<string, (int count, DateTime resetAt)>
SwipeLimitDto with DailyLimit, Used, Remaining, ResetsAt fields
completed.safetyNotes: New files only, in-memory tracking, no DB changes. Rate limit is additive.

completed.title: Add Match Statistics Endpoint

Returns ApiResponse wrapper if available, otherwise plain DTO
completed.safetyNotes: Read-only endpoint, new files only, no mutations.

completed.title: Add Profile Completeness Calculator
completed.description: Create a service that calculates profile completeness percentage. Checks: has name (10%), has birthday (10%), has gender (10%), has bio (15%), has photos >= 1 (20%), has photos >= 3 (10%), has location (10%), has interests (15%). Returns a DTO with overall percentage, per-field status, and suggestions for next steps. Add GET /api/userprofiles/{userId}/completeness endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: ProfileCompletenessService implementation with weighted field checks
ProfileCompletenessDto with Percentage, FilledFields list, MissingFields list, NextSuggestion
ProfileFieldStatus enum or record with FieldName, IsFilled, Weight
GET endpoint on ProfileController returning completeness DTO
completed.safetyNotes: Read-only calculation, new files only, uses existing UserProfile model.
